question: Where is hole 9's putting surface? The model's traced ring is an area outlier and its centroid disagrees with the GolfTraxx survey by 48 m.
finding: The model's green-9 ring is a green COMPLEX read as one shape: it takes in the approach south of the putting surface. Its centroid therefore falls on the apron rather than on the green.
status: measured, not corrected -- a re-trace is a measurement, not an edit, and is left as the next step with the instrument now built

records.reading: the fifteen greens the GolfTraxx survey agrees with measure 308..528 m2. Hole 9's ring is 3.2x the largest of them and nearly 80 m long, which no putting surface on this course is.

records.record: the club's card against the traced corridor
records.measurement: the modelled line runs 375.1 m against a card 334 m, +12.3%
records.reading: the only hole of the eighteen whose modelled line exceeds its card, which a played line cannot do: the played length is measured along the playing line, so a corridor polyline to the real green can never be longer. Retargeted onto the survey's green centre it becomes -7.9%, inside the -5.7..-17.0% band the fifteen agreed holes occupy.
48.15 m from the model's centroid, while agreeing with the other fifteen at a median 2.09 m and a maximum 3.24 m.

records.measurement: visbybuild/cache/crops/ortho-green9.png, 200 m window at native 0.16 m
records.reading: the two greenside bunkers flank the NORTHERN part of the ring; their midpoint is near local (-535, 133). Early-spring turf flattens the mow contrast, so the collar is legible but the putting-surface edge is not traceable from this frame alone.

records.record: Region Gotland 0.25 m orthophoto, summer capture labelled 2022
records.reading: leaf-on and mown: a distinctly darker, uniformly mown oval runs roughly local x -556..-511, z 106..144, centred near (-533, 125). The model's ring continues about 40 m south of it over ground that reads as paler approach. This is the frame that separates the putting surface from the complex.

convergence: Four records that never entered each other put the putting surface north of the model's centroid: the survey at (-529, 116), the bunker midpoint at (-535, 133), the summer mow oval centred near (-533, 125). They agree within 18 m of each other and disagree with the model's (-543, 162) by 30..48 m.
nextStep: Re-trace the ring on the summer capture with the same rule the other greens were traced by, then re-run visbybuild/mapping/golftraxx-review.mjs: hole 9 should move from modelRecordDisputed into the agreed set. Do not hand-place it; the tools are visbybuild/ortho-crop.mjs (--gotland for the summer frame) and visbybuild/sat-crop.mjs.
caveat: Neither orthophoto is approved control. The 0.16 m frame is served by Lantmateriet's public viewing service and its derivative terms are unresolved; the Gotland capture's terms are likewise open. Both are used here as tracing and review evidence and neither is redistributed.
